name: promptit
description: Slash-command prompt launcher for ChatGPT and Gemini

scripts.build:test: node scripts/run-command.mjs --env VITE_PROMPTIT_TEST_MODE=1 --env PROMPTIT_BUILD_OUT_DIR=dist-test -- vite build
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:test && node scripts/run-command.mjs --xvfb-auto --unset NO_COLOR --env PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 --env PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test -- playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:live: pnpm build:test && node scripts/run-command.mjs --xvfb-auto --unset NO_COLOR --env PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 --env PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test -- playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts && pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest
scripts.test:e2e:live:prod: pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest && node scripts/run-command.mjs --xvfb-auto --unset NO_COLOR --env PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 --env PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist -- playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts tests/live/live-prod-insert.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:headed: pnpm build:test && node scripts/run-command.mjs --xvfb-auto --unset NO_COLOR --env PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 --env PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test -- playwright test --headed
scripts.test:e2e:ui: pnpm build:test && node scripts/run-command.mjs --xvfb-auto --unset NO_COLOR --env PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 --env PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test -- playwright test --ui
